name: WLC Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: A mid-card singles title contested in a tournament before the promotion's own January 1999 relaunch of its weekly broadcast.

name: WLC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top title, won through a tournament and defended in a chaotic four-way match that ended without a clean finish.

name: WLC Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a same-night tournament at the federation's own first pay-per-view.
